description: Draw and inspect Excalidraw diagrams through the Excalidraw MCP server.

fields.label: MCP Endpoint URL
fields.description: Optional Excalidraw MCP endpoint. Leave blank to use the public hosted server. Self-hosted remote deployments can point at their own MCP URL, such as a /mcp endpoint.

actions.name: create_view
actions.description: Render a hand-drawn Excalidraw diagram from a JSON array string of elements.

elements.description: A compact JSON array string of Excalidraw elements. Call read_me first for the element format and ordering rules.

inputSchema.description: Input for rendering a diagram with the Excalidraw MCP create_view tool.

checkpointId.description: The Excalidraw checkpoint ID returned by the tool.

content.description: The confirmation message returned by the tool.

outputSchema.description: The result of rendering a diagram with Excalidraw MCP.

actions.name: read_me
actions.description: Fetch the Excalidraw element format guide and drawing tips from the MCP server.

content.description: The Excalidraw MCP reference text returned by read_me.
